description: Open Waters shared Renovate preset. Consumers extend it with github>Open-Waters-Digital/analytics-contract//renovate/default.

hostRules.description: Installs the private contract package. GITHUB_PACKAGES_TOKEN is an organisation secret in the Renovate app, a GitHub token with read:packages only.

packageRules.description: Every other dependency, grouped into one weekly pull request so consumers are not flooded. Majors stay separate, because each needs reading.
Contract fixes change no event or API: merged unattended once the consumer's own CI passes.
A new taxonomy version (minor) or a breaking API (major) can need new markup or wiring on the site, so a person reviews it.
